subject: 20 GP
text: A chest containing 20 GP is located inside the western building on Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Enter this building and collect the chest inside, a whole whopping 20 GP.

subject: Opal Armor
text: A building on Floor 2 contains a chest with the Opal Armor, the best armor a Knight can find.

evidence.quote: You'll come to a building with the Opal Armor inside it, the best armor which a Knight can buy (well find in this case).

subject: Light Axe
text: A chest located all the way south on Floor 2 contains a Light Axe.

evidence.quote: Continue heading all the way south, and you'll find a chest which contains a Light Axe inside it.

subject: Light Axe
text: The Light Axe has a built-in Hrm2 effect that can be used infinitely in battle.

evidence.quote: While this axe isn't really good enough to be equipped, it does have the Hrm2 affect built into it, and it can be used infinetly but only in battle.

subject: Mage Staff
text: A building to the northeast on Floor 2 contains a chest holding the Mage Staff.

evidence.quote: Exit the room, and head back to the north, and then east, and you'll find another building with a treasure chest inside and it holds the Mage Staff.

subject: Mage Staff
text: The Mage Staff has a built-in spell effect that casts Fir2.

evidence.quote: This is another item with a spell affect on it, in this case Fir2.

subject: 12,350 GP
text: A building right next to the staircase leading to the third floor contains a chest with 12,350 GP.

evidence.quote: Inside this building, you'll find a treasure worth 12,350 GP. Once finished, head up the staircase to the third floor.

subject: Slab
text: The third floor of the Sea Shrine holds the Slab, which features ancient language symbols.

evidence.quote: The main item you are looking for on this floor is the Slab, which will play a key part to the story later on.

subject: Opal Bracelet
text: The third floor contains the rest of the Opal gear and the Opal Bracelet.

evidence.quote: Some of the good items to be found down here are the rest of the Opal gear and the Opal Bracelet, among a few other goodies.

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Bringing the Slab to Dr. Unne in Melmond prompts him to teach you how to speak the forgotten language.

evidence.quote: He will notice that the Slab you have is the key to understanding a long forgotten language, and he will teach you how to speak it.

subject: Lif2
text: The Level 8 White Magic spell Lif2 is sold in Lefein for 60000 GP.

evidence.quote:
White Magic Shop: (level 8)
[Lif2             60000 GP]

subject: Nuke
text: The Level 8 Black Magic spell Nuke is sold in Lefein for 60000 GP.

evidence.quote:
Black Magic Shop: (level 8)
[Nuke             60000 GP]

subject: Magic Shops
text: The secret magic shops in Lefein are reached through a single path in the northeastern corner.

evidence.quote: First thing to do when entering this town is to find the secret magic shops which are from the northeastern corner, and through a small single path, and both are very good spells.

subject: Chime
text: The southernmost resident on the eastern side of the river gives you the Chime needed to enter the Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote: The only one which you are required to talk to, is the sothernmost person on the eastern side of the river. He will give you the Chime, which he says is required to enter the Mirage Tower.

subject: Heal Helmet
text: Floor 1 of the Mirage Tower contains a Heal Helmet, which casts the Heal spell when used in battle.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have plenty of free slots open for your armor, as there are a lot of armors to be found on this floor such as the Heal Helmet which should be equipped on your Knight or Ninja. Much like the Heal Staff you found earlier, it will use the Heal spell when used in battle.

subject: Aegis Shield
text: Floor 1 of the Mirage Tower contains the Aegis Shield, which shields Knights from Stone attacks.

evidence.quote: The Aegis Shield is also a must equip here, as it will protect your Knights from the ill affects of the Stone attacks.

subject: Vorpal
text: The Vorpal weapon is found in a treasure chest on the first floor of the Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote: The Vorpal weapon also found on the first floor isn't nothing to get excited about, as its power is way weaker than any other weapons you may have at this time.

subject: Thor Hammer
text: Mirage Tower Floor 2 contains the Thor Hammer in a treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Some of the great finds in the treasure chests here are the Thor Hammer and Sun Sword.

subject: Thor Hammer
text: The Thor Hammer acts as a Lit2 item in battle.

evidence.quote: Equip the Thor Hammer on your White Wizard, and move the Zeus Gauntlet to the Black Wizard, as having two Lit2 items at the same time is pointless because you can only use one or the other, but not both at the same time on the same character.

subject: Sun Sword
text: Mirage Tower Floor 2 contains the Sun Sword in a treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Some of the great finds in the treasure chests here are the Thor Hammer and Sun Sword... Equip the Sun Sword on your Knight, and enjoy the power of the fourth best weapon in the game

subject: Dragon Armor
text: Mirage Tower Floor 2 contains the Dragon Armor, which provides the same stats as the Opal Armor.

evidence.quote: You can equip the Dragon Armor if you wish, but it has the same stats as the Opal Armor (but it makes for a great suppliment if you have two Knights)

subject: Blue Dragon
text: A Blue Dragon with a powerful thunder attack guards the building doorway on Floor 3 of the Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote: Make sure you are fully healed when you enter the door to the building in the center of the room, as you'll have to fight a Blue Dragon, and it has a powerful thunder attack, and it usually gets the first attack.

subject: Bane Sword
text: A building directly south of the start on Sky Castle Floor 4 contains the Bane Sword.

evidence.quote: On the first floor of the Sky Castle, head directly south to the building down there and collect your Bane Sword.

subject: Bane Sword
text: Using the Bane Sword in battle produces the Bane spell.

evidence.quote: Using it in battle will produce a Bane Spell.

subject: Heal Potion
text: The western building on Sky Castle Floor 4 contains a Heal Potion and gold.

evidence.quote: Enter the building and collect the Heal Potion and the gold, and go back to the east and enter that building over there.

subject: Heal Helmet
text: The eastern building on Sky Castle Floor 4 contains 6,720 GP, another Heal Helmet, a ProRing, 5,000 GP, and 180 GP.

evidence.quote: Inside you'll find 6,720 GP, another Heal Helmet, a ProRing, 5,000 GP, and 180 GP.

subject: Silver Helmet
text: The northwestern prong on Sky Castle Floor 5 holds a House and a Silver Helmet.

evidence.quote: The northwestern prong holds a House, and a Silver Helmet.

subject: Opal Gauntlet
text: The northeastern prong on Sky Castle Floor 5 holds an Opal Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: The northeastern prong holds an Opal Gauntlet.

subject: 880 GP
text: The western prong on Sky Castle Floor 5 holds 880 and 13,000 GP.

evidence.quote: The western prong holds 880 and 13,000 GP.

subject: Ribbon
text: The eastern prong on Sky Castle Floor 5 holds a Ribbon and an Opal Shield.

evidence.quote: The eastern prong holds a Ribbon, and an Opal Shield.

subject: Adamant
text: The southwestern prong on Sky Castle Floor 5 houses the Adamant.

evidence.quote: The southwestern prong houses the Adamant, while the southeastern prong holds the Black and White Shirts.

subject: Black Shirt
text: The southeastern prong on Sky Castle Floor 5 contains the Black and White Shirts.

evidence.quote: while the southeastern prong holds the Black and White Shirts.

subject: Black Shirt
text: The Black Shirt casts Ice2 when used, while the White Shirt casts Inv2 in battle.

evidence.quote: The Black Shirt casts Ice2 when used, while the White Shirt casts Inv2 in battle.

subject: ProCape
text: The east building on Sky Castle Floor 6 contains a ProCape, gold, a second ProCape, a Cloth, and a Soft Potion.

evidence.quote: Inside you'll find a ProCape, some gold, a ProCape, a Cloth (drop it immediatly) and a Soft Potion.

subject: Window
text: Looking out the window on Sky Castle Floor 6 gives a hint about where to travel for the end of the game.

evidence.quote: If you want you can look out the window here, as it gives you a hint as to where to go for the end of the game.

subject: Katana
text: A room directly west from the Floor 6 window contains a Soft Potion, 4,150 GP, 3,400 GP, and the Katana.

evidence.quote: Directly west from the window, you'll find a treasure room with a Soft Potion, 4,150 GP, 3,400 GP, and the Katana inside.

subject: ProRing
text: A treasure room north of the Floor 6 window contains four chests with a ProRing, 9,000 GP, 5,450 GP, and a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote: Also if you go north from the window, you'll come across another treasure room with four chests in it, and they hold a ProRing, 9,000 GP, 5,450 GP, and a Heal Potion.

subject: Floor 7
text: Moving in a north and then west path repeated two or three times leads to the teleport for the final floor of Sky Castle.

evidence.quote: If you move in a north and then west path and repeat two or three times you'll come to the teleport to the final floor.

subject: WarMech
text: WarMech patrols the bridge to the north on Floor 8 of the Sky Castle.

evidence.quote: Do be warned, that the toughest monster in the game, WarMech, makes this bridge his place of business.

subject: WarMech
text: WarMech can strike for 200-400 damage and casts Nuclear on the whole party 85-90% of the time as its first action.

evidence.quote: It can hit for about 200-400 even on a Knight, and it uses Nuclear, which hits for about the same or even more on the whole party. To make matters worse, it usually gets the jump on your party, well being a machine its to be expected, and it uses Nuclear about 85-90% of the time first thing, so if you are not healed, it could quite easily wipe out your party before you know what hit you.

subject: WarMech
text: Players encounter WarMech on the Floor 8 bridge with a 1 in 64 chance.

evidence.quote: Now this has happened to me before and it wasn't much fun, but I think I read back in the days of the Nintendo Power Stradegy Guide for Final Fantasy, that you only have a 1 in 64 chance of fighting WarMech.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat has 1000 HP and has no elemental weakness, though Brak and Bane may work.

evidence.quote:
Boss: Tiamat

HP: 1000
Weakness: None (Brak and Bane might work if you want to chance using
it.)

subject: Tiamat
text: Against Tiamat, casting Alit and Aice counters Thunder and Blizzard attacks, while Inv2 helps avoid physical strikes.

evidence.quote: I would have your White Wizard put up Alit and Aice, as Tiamat uses both the Thunder and Blizzard attacks... In the second round, have your Red and White Wizard use Inv2 to help avoid with Tiamat's physically hits which are decent as far as monster damage goes.
